name: almost_swapped
root_cause: Adjacent assignments overwrite a variable before swapping.
fix: Use Luau tuple swap: a, b = b, a.

name: divide_by_zero
root_cause: Literal division by zero produces inf or nan in Luau.
fix: Guard divisor with `if divisor == 0 then return end`.

name: duplicate_keys
root_cause: Duplicate key in table literal silently overwrites the earlier value.
fix: Remove or rename the duplicate table key.

name: global_usage
root_cause: Implicit global assignment pollutes _G and bypasses Luau fast-local VM registers.
fix: Declare variables with `local`.

name: shadowing
root_cause: Inner `local` shadows an outer variable of the same name.
fix: Rename the inner variable to avoid masking state.

name: deprecated_wait
root_cause: Legacy `wait()` throttles on the 30Hz pipeline and can stall indefinitely.
fix: Replace `wait()` with `task.wait()`.

name: deprecated_spawn
root_cause: Legacy `spawn()` introduces a frame delay and hides stack context.
fix: Replace `spawn()` with `task.spawn()`.

name: deprecated_delay
root_cause: Legacy `delay()` uses the older 30Hz task scheduler.
fix: Replace `delay()` with `task.delay()`.

name: empty_if
root_cause: Empty `if` branch indicates dead logic or an unfinished guard.
fix: Implement the branch or remove the conditional.

name: if_same_then_else
root_cause: Both branches of an `if` expression return the identical value.
fix: Simplify the redundant conditional.

name: mismatched_arg_count
root_cause: string.format called without format arguments.
fix: Pass matching arguments or use plain string concatenation.

name: mixed_table
root_cause: Mixing array and dictionary keys in one table breaks ipairs and JSON serialization.
fix: Separate array and map data into distinct tables.

name: parenthese_conditions
root_cause: C-style parenthesized `if (...) then` condition is redundant in Luau.
fix: Remove outer parentheses around conditions.

name: roblox_incorrect_color3_new_bounds
root_cause: Color3.new expects 0..1 floats; passing >1 clamps to white.
fix: Use Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) for 0..255 values.

name: roblox_manual_fromscale_or_fromoffset
root_cause: UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y) can be written more clearly with fromOffset.
fix: Use UDim2.fromOffset(x, y) or UDim2.fromScale(x, y).

name: unbalanced_assignments
root_cause: Multiple locals declared with fewer right-hand expressions leaves trailing nil.
fix: Assign explicit values to each declared local.

name: undefined_variable
root_cause: Reference to undeclared identifier evaluates to nil at runtime.
fix: Declare the variable or import the required module.

name: unused_variable
root_cause: Unused local allocation adds noise and dead register pressure.
fix: Remove unused locals or prefix intentionally ignored ones with `_`.

name: compare_nan
root_cause: Comparing against a literal `nan` fails IEEE-754 semantics.
fix: Check NaN with `x ~= x`.

name: type_checking_comparison
root_cause: Comparing typeof(x) == 'nil' is slower than `x == nil`.
fix: Use direct `x == nil` comparison.

name: missing_strict_mode
root_cause: Script lacks `--!strict` directive, hiding type mismatches until runtime.
fix: Add `--!strict` at line 1 of critical modules.

name: any_type_escape
root_cause: Explicit `any` annotation disables Luau static type verification.
fix: Replace `any` with concrete table/union types or `unknown`.

name: cast_to_any
root_cause: Type cast `:: any` suppresses compiler diagnostics on unsafe boundaries.
fix: Validate the runtime shape with `typeof()` and narrow the type.

name: untyped_remote_callback
root_cause: Remote callback parameters lack Luau type annotations.
fix: Annotate `(player: Player, ...: unknown)` and validate each argument.

name: optional_index_unchecked
root_cause: Direct property access on FindFirstChild result crashes if nil.
fix: Assign to a local and guard `if child then ... end`.

name: character_unchecked
root_cause: Direct indexing on `player.Character` fails during respawn before CharacterAdded.
fix: Use `local char = player.Character; if not char then return end`.

name: primary_part_unchecked
root_cause: Accessing `model.PrimaryPart` without a nil guard throws when StreamingEnabled unloads parts.
fix: Guard `local root = model.PrimaryPart; if not root then return end`.

name: deprecated_ipairs_for_gen
root_cause: Explicit `ipairs()` is slower than Luau generalized iteration.
fix: Use generalized iteration: `for i, v in list do`.

name: deprecated_pairs_for_gen
root_cause: Explicit `pairs()` is unnecessary with Luau generalized iteration.
fix: Use generalized iteration: `for k, v in dict do`.

name: string_byte_oob
root_cause: Luau strings are 1-indexed; passing 0 in string.sub is off-by-one.
fix: Use 1-based start indices in string.sub.

name: table_insert_in_hotloop
root_cause: Inserting at index 1 shifts the entire array in O(n) per call.
fix: Append to the end or use a ring buffer.

name: table_remove_shift
root_cause: Removing index 1 shifts all elements in O(n).
fix: Use swap-remove or a head-index queue.

name: coroutine_resume_unwrapped
root_cause: coroutine.resume swallows errors unless the first boolean return is checked.
fix: Check `local ok, err = coroutine.resume(co)` or use `task.spawn`.

name: pcall_ignored_status
root_cause: Calling `pcall()` without capturing `ok, err` hides runtime failures.
fix: Capture `local ok, err = pcall(...)` and log/handle failures.

name: xpcall_missing_handler
root_cause: xpcall requires a second error-handler function argument.
fix: Pass `debug.traceback` as the error handler.

name: require_dynamic_expr
root_cause: Dynamic require expressions prevent static type resolution in luau-lsp.
fix: Use static script path references for require().

name: getfenv_deopt
root_cause: getfenv() disables Luau VM fastcall and native codegen optimizations.
fix: Remove getfenv() and pass dependencies explicitly.

name: setfenv_deopt
root_cause: setfenv() breaks Luau compiler optimizations and type inference.
fix: Avoid setfenv() in modern Luau modules.

name: loadstring_client_invalid
root_cause: loadstring() is blocked on clients and is an RCE risk on servers.
fix: Replace loadstring() with static dispatch tables.

name: untyped_export_module
root_cause: Module returns an empty untyped table.
fix: Export explicit Luau types via `export type`.

name: native_codegen_candidate
root_cause: Module uses `--!native`; verify hot math loops avoid polymorphic tables.
fix: Profile `<native>` frames in Roblox Script Profiler.

name: debug_profilebegin_unclosed
root_cause: Unpaired debug.profilebegin() without debug.profileend() corrupts MicroProfiler scopes.
fix: Pair every debug.profilebegin() with debug.profileend().

name: table_clear_vs_realloc
root_cause: Reallocating `{}` inside a frame loop increases GC pressure.
fix: Use `table.clear(buf)` to reuse pre-allocated buffers.

name: table_create_missing
root_cause: Large numeric loop building an array without `table.create(n)` causes repeated resizes.
fix: Pre-size arrays with `table.create(n)`.

name: string_concat_in_loop
root_cause: Repeated `..` string concatenation in loops allocates O(n^2) intermediate strings.
fix: Accumulate parts in an array and call `table.concat(parts)`.

name: math_pow_vs_mul
root_cause: Exponentiation `x ^ 2` invokes pow() instead of single-instruction multiply.
fix: Use `x * x` in tight vector/physics loops.

name: vector3_magnitude_vs_dot
root_cause: Comparing `.Magnitude` computes a square root unnecessarily.
fix: Compare squared lengths via `v:Dot(v) < r * r` when appropriate.

name: buffer_library_opportunity
root_cause: Packed binary serialization can use the zero-copy Luau `buffer` library.
fix: Consider `buffer.create` / `buffer.writeu32` for binary packets.

name: task_wait_zero_spin
root_cause: Busy `while true do task.wait() end` polling wastes frame budget.
fix: Drive state transitions via Signals or RBXScriptSignals.

name: renderstepped_heavy_work
root_cause: Heavy logic in RenderStepped blocks frame rendering on low-end clients.
fix: Move non-camera logic to Heartbeat or fixed-step accumulators.

name: heartbeat_unbounded_loop
root_cause: Ensure Heartbeat callbacks stay bounded (<1ms) and disconnect on cleanup.
fix: Profile Heartbeat callback duration with debug.profilebegin().

name: json_encode_hotpath
root_cause: Calling JSONEncode per frame on large tables spikes CPU and heap.
fix: Throttle or batch telemetry JSON serialization.

name: getdescendants_hotpath
root_cause: Calling GetDescendants() inside Heartbeat/Touched scans the full subtree repeatedly.
fix: Cache tracked instances via DescendantAdded/Removing or CollectionService.

name: findfirstchild_recursive
root_cause: Recursive FindFirstChild(..., true) performs a full DFS traversal.
fix: Use CollectionService tags or direct references.

name: clone_without_pool
root_cause: Frequent :Clone() calls on projectiles/VFX fragment instance memory.
fix: Use an object pool or Debris:AddItem() with bounded lifetimes.

name: parallel_luau_desync
root_cause: Parallel Luau actor code must call `task.synchronize()` before mutating Instances.
fix: Verify `task.synchronize()` precedes any DataModel writes.

name: debug_traceback_hot
root_cause: Capturing debug.traceback() on every event call creates heavy string allocations.
fix: Only invoke debug.traceback() inside error handlers.

name: os_clock_precision
root_cause: Legacy `tick()` is timezone-dependent and deprecated in favor of os.clock/workspace.
fix: Use `os.clock()` for deltas or `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()` for sync.

name: collectionservice_uncleaned
root_cause: CollectionService added listeners without corresponding removal cleanup leak state.
fix: Pair GetInstanceAddedSignal with GetInstanceRemovedSignal.

name: gcinfo_spike_watch
root_cause: Manual gcinfo() checks should be paired with Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb().
fix: Track memory trend deltas over 10s windows.

name: untracked_connect
root_cause: RBXScriptConnection created without storing or registering with Trove/Janitor.
fix: Store the connection or attach via `trove:Connect(signal, fn)`.

name: player_removing_missing
root_cause: PlayerAdded listener without PlayerRemoving cleanup leaks per-player tables.
fix: Clean up player state in `Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(...)`.

name: character_added_leak
root_cause: CharacterAdded connections created inside loops leak on respawn.
fix: Attach character connections to a per-character Trove/Janitor.

name: destroying_not_bound
root_cause: Bind cleanup to `instance.Destroying` or `janitor:LinkToInstance(inst)`.
fix: Use LinkToInstance or Trove:AttachToInstance().

name: instance_new_parent_first
root_cause: Passing parent as 2nd argument to Instance.new() triggers extra property replication.
fix: Set properties first, then assign `.Parent` last.

name: tween_uncleaned
root_cause: Created Tweens hold strong references to targets until completed or destroyed.
fix: Call `tween:Destroy()` or register with Trove/Janitor.

name: task_spawn_untracked
root_cause: Long-lived `task.spawn` threads can continue running after entity destruction.
fix: Cancel spawned threads with `task.cancel(thread)` via Trove/Janitor.

name: bind_to_renderstep_leak
root_cause: RunService:BindToRenderStep without UnbindFromRenderStep leaks callbacks.
fix: Pair with `RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(name)` on cleanup.

name: contextaction_unbound
root_cause: ContextActionService:BindAction without UnbindAction leaves stale input bindings.
fix: Unbind actions when tools unequip or UI closes.

name: userinput_leak
root_cause: Global UserInputService connections inside temporary UIs leak across opens.
fix: Disconnect input listeners when UI unmounts.

name: attribute_changed_leak
root_cause: Attribute changed signals must be disconnected when the observed instance is removed.
fix: Track the connection in Trove/Janitor.

name: property_changed_leak
root_cause: Property changed signals retain closures until disconnected.
fix: Clean up via Trove/Janitor.

name: strong_player_key_table
root_cause: Using Player instances as table keys leaks Player memory if not cleared on leave.
fix: Clear `tbl[player] = nil` on PlayerRemoving or key by `player.UserId`.

name: sound_ended_uncleaned
root_cause: Dynamically cloned Sounds must be destroyed after Ended fires.
fix: Use `Debris:AddItem(sound, sound.TimeLength + 0.5)` or `trove:Add(sound)`.

name: debris_zero_or_missing
root_cause: Verify Debris:AddItem lifetime is positive and finite.
fix: Pass a bounded positive duration (e.g. 2-5 seconds).

name: raycast_params_realloc
root_cause: Allocating RaycastParams.new() every frame adds unnecessary GC churn.
fix: Reuse a cached RaycastParams object and update FilterDescendantsInstances.

name: overlap_params_realloc
root_cause: Re-creating OverlapParams inside spatial query loops wastes allocations.
fix: Hoist OverlapParams outside the loop.

name: weak_table_hint
root_cause: Weak tables still require explicit cleanup for Instance keys in some cycles.
fix: Prefer explicit Trove/Janitor destruction.

name: child_added_unbounded
root_cause: ChildAdded callbacks that allocate state per child need ChildRemoved cleanup.
fix: Pair ChildAdded with ChildRemoved or Destroying.

name: descendant_added_heavy
root_cause: DescendantAdded on Workspace fires for every part/particle spawned.
fix: Filter fast with `if not inst:IsA(...) then return end`.

name: iris_loop_guard
root_cause: Iris UI calls must be wrapped inside Iris:Connect() or guarded against nil state.
fix: Ensure Iris.Init() is called once on the client.

name: cmdr_hook_missing
root_cause: Cmdr commands without a BeforeRun hook expose admin commands to all players.
fix: Register a server BeforeRun hook checking `context.Executor` rank.

name: testez_describe_missing_expect
root_cause: TestEZ spec should assert concrete post-conditions via `expect(...).to`.
fix: Verify both happy-path and exploit/invalid-input cases.

name: signal_reentrancy
root_cause: Custom Signal:Fire() handlers can trigger re-entrant mutations if state updates after Fire.
fix: Update authoritative state before firing signals.

name: reactive_effect_cleanup
root_cause: Reactive effects must return or register a cleanup disposer.
fix: Dispose effects when UI components unmount.

name: admin_command_client_check
root_cause: Never rely solely on client-side admin checks for command visibility/execution.
fix: Enforce admin UserId/GroupRank checks on the server.

name: debug_gui_prod_leak
root_cause: Ensure debug overlays are gated to Studio or authorized developers.
fix: Check `RunService:IsStudio()` or server-verified developer UserIds.

name: mock_remote_boundary
root_cause: RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke yields the caller and can hang if a handler errors.
fix: Wrap OnServerInvoke logic in pcall and validate all return values.

name: bindable_event_yield
root_cause: BindableEvent:Fire() deep-copies table arguments (stripping metatables).
fix: Pass plain serializable tables or use pure-Luau Signal modules.

name: streaming_waitforchild_timeout
root_cause: WaitForChild without a timeout yields forever if the instance never replicates.
fix: Pass a numeric timeout: `WaitForChild(name, 5)`.

name: content_provider_unbounded
root_cause: Preloading huge descendant lists blocks client loading screens.
fix: Preload only critical assets in small batches.

name: humanoid_state_client_owned
root_cause: Client owns Humanoid physics; setting WalkSpeed client-side is trivially bypassed.
fix: Validate movement velocity/displacement on the server.

name: network_ownership_auto
root_cause: Calling SetNetworkOwner on anchored parts throws an error.
fix: Verify `not part.Anchored` and `part:IsDescendantOf(workspace)` first.

name: datastore_getasync_unwrapped
root_cause: DataStore GetAsync() can throw on Roblox API outages or throttling.
fix: Wrap DataStore calls in pcall() with bounded exponential backoff.

name: datastore_budget_exhaust
root_cause: Unthrottled DataStore writes on RemoteEvents exhaust the per-minute request budget.
fix: Cache player data in memory and save periodically + on PlayerRemoving/BindToClose.

name: bind_to_close_missing
root_cause: Server shutdowns can drop final DataStore saves without game:BindToClose().
fix: Save all active player profiles inside `game:BindToClose()`.

name: marketplace_gamepass_cache
root_cause: UserOwnsGamePassAsync caches results and can fail without pcall.
fix: Wrap in pcall() and handle PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished.

name: group_rank_cache
root_cause: GetRankInGroup makes a web call and can fail if not wrapped in pcall.
fix: Cache group rank on PlayerAdded inside pcall().

name: remote_nan_check
root_cause: Validating `typeof(x) == 'number'` alone still lets `0/0` (NaN) pass comparisons.
fix: Always pair with `x == x` and `math.abs(x) < math.huge`.

name: remote_table_depth
root_cause: Accepting arbitrary client tables without key/depth limits risks stack overflow.
fix: Validate table key count, types, and maximum nesting depth.

name: breakpoint_print_leftover
root_cause: Leftover debug `print()` statements clutter production Developer Console.
fix: Remove temporary debug prints or gate behind a debug flag.

name: warn_without_context
root_cause: Generic warning message lacks instance path or player context.
fix: Include script name, player UserId, and failing parameter.

name: os_clock_delta
root_cause: Measure hot-path execution deltas with os.clock() outside tight inner loops.
fix: Aggregate timings over batches to avoid timer overhead.

name: remote_fire_in_loop
root_cause: Firing a RemoteEvent inside a loop multiplies packet headers and overhead.
fix: Batch items into a single array payload and fire once.

name: unreliable_remote_candidate
root_cause: High-frequency visual/position broadcasts over reliable RemoteEvents cause head-of-line blocking.
fix: Use UnreliableRemoteEvent for transient VFX/position updates.

name: valuebase_trust_server
root_cause: Never read client-modifiable ValueBase instances inside Character for server authority.
fix: Keep authoritative leaderstats updates strictly server-driven.

name: workspace_remote_placement
root_cause: Dynamically creating RemoteEvents inside Workspace fragments network boundaries.
fix: Place static RemoteEvents inside ReplicatedStorage.

name: tool_activated_server_check
root_cause: Tool.Activated on server/client must verify tool ownership and cooldown.
fix: Check `tool.Parent == player.Character` and enforce cooldown.

name: seat_occupant_check
root_cause: Verify occupant is a valid living Player character before granting vehicle control.
fix: Check `Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(occupant.Parent)`.

name: raycast_origin_trust
root_cause: Server raycasts for weapons must originate from server character head/muzzle, not client origin.
fix: Compute raycast origin on the server and validate direction length.

name: explosion_hit_validation
root_cause: Explosion.Hit fires for every part in radius; validate character/team before applying damage.
fix: Deduplicate per character and respect forcefield/team checks.

name: sound_respect_filtering
root_cause: With RespectFilteringEnabled = false, client-played sounds replicate globally.
fix: Keep SoundService.RespectFilteringEnabled = true.

name: chat_filter_async
root_cause: FilterStringAsync must be wrapped in pcall and use GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync.
fix: Always wrap TextService filtering in pcall with fallback.

name: textchat_onincoming
root_cause: TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage runs locally; never trust it for server moderation.
fix: Enforce chat cooldowns and commands on the server.

name: physics_collision_group
root_cause: Ensure projectiles/NPCs use PhysicsService CollisionGroups instead of per-part CanCollide hacks.
fix: Register collision groups at server startup.

name: shadow_cast_vfx
root_cause: Particle/VFX/debris parts with CastShadow = true waste GPU shadow-map budget.
fix: Set `CastShadow = false` on VFX and small detail parts.

name: canquery_cantouch_vfx
root_cause: Non-interactive decorative parts with CanTouch/CanQuery = true bloat spatial queries.
fix: Set `CanTouch = false` and `CanQuery = false` on decorative parts.

name: task_defer_order
root_cause: Deferred execution runs at the next resumption point; avoid relying on immediate side effects.
fix: Design signal handlers to be order-independent.

name: logservice_messageout
root_cause: LogService.MessageOut handlers must not call print()/warn() unconditionally or they recurse.
fix: Guard against recursive logging inside MessageOut.

name: scriptcontext_error
root_cause: ScriptContext.Error captures unhandled runtime stack traces for telemetry.
fix: Forward stack traces without leaking secrets to clients.
